fact: Mauritian Standards published January to October 2025 include MS ISO/IEC 22989:2022, 23894:2023, 42001:2023, 38507:2022 and 27403:2024, adopting ISO/IEC information technology standards, the first notified in the Gazette on 25 January 2025.
title: Mauritian Standards Published (Jan - October 2025)
